title: Incorporation and deposition behaviors of Zn into the channel of hydroxyapatite
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,38147-38157
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06364G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Xiao Chen, Kanji Saito, Takashi Toyao, Yuriko Ando, Ken-ichi Shimizu, Masataka Ogasawara, Sumio Kato
Incorporation/release of Zn into/from the hydroxyapatite (Hap) channel upon heat treatment under varying humidity were investigated to find the Hap with the largest Zn content in the channel so far as well as deposition of ZnO fine particle.
